La Rosée is above all a human adventure, driven by tight-knit, passionate, and dedicated teams united around one goal: inventing natural, effective, and eco-designed cosmetic products. To achieve this, we are looking for a Marketing Manager - Retail & Brand 🌿✨

💬 Your mission
The Marketing Manager - Retail & Brand plays a central role in developing La Rosée's presence in Canada, bringing the brand to life across retail partnerships, product launches, PR, events, and social media. You will develop and execute the Canadian retail and brand marketing plan, ensuring that every initiative reflects La Rosée's identity while supporting business growth.
🤝 Your daily interactions
At the heart of the organization, you will collaborate closely with:
• The General Manager, to whom you will directly report.

• The E-Commerce & Digital Manager, to collaboratively build and execute a cohesive 360° marketing plan for Canada.

• Retail partners, including Shoppers Drug Mart/Pharmaprix.

• Internal teams and external creative resources, such as PR agencies and freelance creatives.

• The global headquarters in France, drawing on the team's expertise, brand assets, and resources to maintain close alignment.

🎯 Your main responsibilities

1. Retail Partner & Trade Marketing
• Manage day-to-day marketing relationships with Shoppers Drug Mart/Pharmaprix and other retail partners.

• Develop and execute the retail marketing calendar, including launches, promotions, offers, and retailer programs.

• Coordinate retail marketing materials, displays, promotional sets, GWPs, sampling, and testers.

• Plan and execute in-store events, pop-ups, retailer activations, and other consumer-facing initiatives.

• Prepare retailer presentations, monthly field playbooks, and training webinar materials.

• Coordinate Canadian retail product information requirements and contribute to the global PIM project.

2. Brand Identity & Creative Direction
• Ensure La Rosée's brand identity, visual universe, and creative standards are consistently reflected across Canadian marketing initiatives.

• Provide creative direction for retail materials, campaigns, events, and social content.

• Adapt global brand assets to the Canadian market while maintaining brand consistency.

3. PR, Social Media & Content
• Coordinate with the PR agency to align media and influencer activities with Canadian launches and marketing priorities.

• Develop and manage the organic social media strategy and content calendar.

• Manage social media and freelance creative resources, providing direction, feedback, and ensuring quality and timely execution.

• Monitor social media and PR performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

4. Sales Forecasting & Performance
• Build and maintain sell-in and sell-out forecasts by retailer, product, and period.

• Analyze sales, promotions, and launch performance to identify opportunities and risks.

• Develop and manage the retail marketing budget.

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reporting with recommendations and actions.

💡 Profil required
• 3-5 years of experience in retail marketing, trade marketing, or brand marketing, ideally within beauty, skincare, CPG, or another consumer-focused industry.

• Experience working with major retail partners across pharmacy, beauty, CPG, or department store environments.

• Professional fluency in English and French, written and spoken, is required.

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• A developed visual sensibility and the ability to translate brand identity into compelling marketing executions.

• Experience coordinating creative projects and managing internal or freelance resources.

• Strong commercial understanding, with experience in sales analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.

• Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with PowerPoint and Canva.

• An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, find solutions, and move projects forward proactively.

• Organized, resourceful, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.

🌿 Why join La Rosée ?
Joining La Rosée means becoming part of a fast-growing company committed to simpler, natural, and responsible beauty, driven by strong values: benevolence, high standards, and transparency. You will evolve within a passionate, dynamic, and creative team, where team spirit, brand consistency, and customer satisfaction guide every action, with real freedom to propose ideas and grow the brand every day 🌿✨
💰 Compensation & Benefits
Base salary: $75,000-$90,000 CAD, based on experience, plus an annual performance-based bonus based on individual and company performance.
Full-time
Hybrid
Based in Toronto, ON
🌿 Our JEDI Commitments (Justice • Equity • Diversity • Inclusion)
At La Rosée, we are convinced that the diversity of backgrounds, experiences, and sensitivities is an essential wealth to build a fairer, more innovative, and more human company. We are committed to guaranteeing a recruitment process based on:
• equity and transparency,

• non-discrimination,

• the inclusion of all people, regardless of their gender, age, origin, disability status, sexual orientation, identity, or beliefs. Each application is studied carefully, respecting equal opportunities, so that everyone can find their place and evolve in a caring work environment. ✨ Joining La Rosée means joining a committed team, where everyone can express themselves, progress, and fully contribute to our mission.

Summary

Rosedale United Church and The Rosedale Centre are seeking an experienced, creative and highly organized Marketing, Programs & Events Coordinator to join our small, collaborative staff team, reporting to the Executive Director.

This is a new role created to support the next stage of growth for both the Church and Centre. Over the past several years, we have expanded our community programming, events, rentals and outreach, and we are now looking for someone who can help us strengthen that work, reach new audiences and deliver an increasing number of activities.

We are looking for someone with a unique combination of skills: a strong marketing professional who can build awareness and participation through a variety of promotional streams, an organized and collaborative team member who can support the delivery of programs and events, and a flexible individual willing to help share coverage of evening and weekend rentals and weddings that generate revenue to support our growth.

This is an opportunity to join a growing organization, help expand our reach into the community, and play an important role in delivering high quality programs, events and experiences that bring people through our doors.

Key Responsibilities:

Marketing & Promotions – Primary Focus

• Take ownership of day-to-day marketing and promotion for both Church and Centre programs and events

• Manage weekly promotional updates across the website, weekly church e-newsletter, church bulletin and in-building displays, ensuring content is current, accurate and provided to the right people on time

• Create a new monthly e-newsletter to promote secular programs, events and community activities

• Maintain a consistent, active social media presence and grow audience engagement

• Drive ticket sales and program registrations through active promotion, monitoring results and adjusting content and delivery in real time as needed

• Update and distribute existing Canva-based promotional materials for existing programs and events

• Write and edit clear, engaging content for new digital and print communications

• Capture and use photos, stories and highlights from activities across the Church and Centre for future promotions

• Produce and maintain printed flyers and brochures for programs, events, weddings, rentals and other priority areas

• Maintain consistent branding and professional standards across all communications

Programs, Events & Rentals

• Provide regular on-site support for Church and Centre programs, helping instructors and participants feel welcomed and ensuring activities run smoothly

• Build positive working relationships with instructors, participants, volunteers, renters, community partners and external service providers

• Work closely with the Office Manager to support program registration, participant communications, attendance tracking and instructor needs

• Work with the Executive Director to meet program grant obligations, track required outcomes and support reporting, in particular for Seniors Day at Rosedale

• Assist with program schedules, space usage, class materials and other operational requirements

• Monitor program registrations, ticket sales and budgets, helping keep activities on target and grow participation

• Collaborate with the Executive Director on new program and special event opportunities

• Be a key member of the staff team delivering major Church and Centre special events, including lectures, concerts and community gatherings

• Support event logistics from preparation through delivery, including setup, ticket taking, greeting, hospitality, signage and other operational needs

• Adjust work hours as required to share evening and weekend coverage for weddings, rentals and other building activities and to cover the main office when needed

• When assisting with a rental or wedding, serve as the on-site Rosedale staff contact and provide practical building support, including access, opening and closing, room readiness and general facilities assistance

• Attend monthly staff meetings and contribute to coordinated planning across the Church and Centre

• Undertake other related responsibilities that support successful operations and growth

Experience & Education

• Post-secondary education in marketing, digital media, event management or a related field is preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered

• Minimum three to five years of relevant professional experience, ideally in a nonprofit or charitable organization, community, arts or cultural setting

• Substantial hands-on digital marketing experience and graphic design skills using Canva

• Experience developing content to increase engagement, registrations, and ticket sales

• Experience with event delivery, hospitality and customer-facing operations

• Experience with email marketing platforms, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365

Skills & Personal Qualities

The person who will succeed in this position will be:

• An exceptional writer and communicator with a strong sense of audience, message and tone

• An understanding of the Christian faith and the ability to communicate effectively about both Church and Centre programs and events

• Creative, with a strong visual eye and an instinct for what attracts attention and encourages participation

• Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines

• Self-directed and able to work independently within established priorities

• Comfortable moving between marketing work, program support and hands-on event delivery

• Warm, confident and professional

• Technologically confident and quick to learn new tools and systems

• Adaptable, resourceful and comfortable responding to changing needs

• Collaborative and willing to pitch in as part of a small staff team

• Reliable, committed and enthusiastic about contributing to a busy, hands-on workplace

• Able to exercise sound judgment, discretion and confidentiality

• Committed to creating welcoming and inclusive experiences for people from a wide range of backgrounds

Employment Terms & Compensation:

About Food Banks Canada

At Food Banks Canada, our commitment stretches across the nation, tirelessly supporting and enhancing the work of over 5,500 food banks and community organizations. We invest in, advocate for, and bolster their critical efforts. Through diligent research, we delve into the root causes of food insecurity, devising actionable solutions informed by our findings as we work to create a Canada where no one goes hungry.

In 2024, Waterstone Human Capital recognized our workplace for embodying one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures of the year. This distinction highlights best-in-class Canadian organizations with cultures that have helped them enhance performance. For us, performance means advancing our mission and achieving organizational goals collaboratively with a team that is happy, healthy and engaged.

Our efforts and impact are expanding, and we're opening doors for passionate, teamwork-driven professionals in search of a career that's both meaningful and captivating. Bilingualism (English/French) is an asset for all our roles at Food Banks Canada as we support Canadians across the country.

About the Role

Are you a data-driven marketing professional with a passion for turning insights into action? We’re seeking a forward-thinking Manager of Marketing to lead the development and execution of strategic, insight-backed campaigns that engage and inspire across the full donor journey. In this pivotal role, you’ll harness the power of market research, performance data, and audience insights to inform marketing strategies that elevate our brand, deepen donor relationships, and drive measurable impact. Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you’ll design and maintain robust reporting frameworks, optimize audience journeys, and ensure that every marketing initiative is rooted in evidence and aligned with organizational goals. You’ll collaborate across departments, bring structure to complex projects, and help embed a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, and learning. This is an exciting opportunity for a critical thinker with an entrepreneurial mindset to make a meaningful difference while advancing their career in a mission-driven environment.

What You Will Be Doing
• Work with the Director of Marketing on the execution of marketing strategies which include campaigns for various target audiences, managing market research, researching, and recommending channels and tactics to reach and engage audiences
• Collaborate with the VP, Marketing and Communications and Director of Marketing on strategy development as needed
• Create and maintain a journey mapping reporting framework to inform, data-driven recommendations to optimize each stage of the audience journey
• Track and report on key metrics and ROI of marketing initiatives, including weekly and monthly reports on tactics across various channels
• Support all Food Bank Canada’s internal teams with change management in terms of brand guidelines, marketing assets, and organizational messaging
• Build relationships across internal teams to ensure the marketing team has up to date qualitative data from those owning each touchpoint across the audience journey and meeting their needs
• Provide leadership to direct reports through coaching, mentorship and managing performance

What You Will Need
• Completion of an undergraduate degree or equivalent
• Minimum of 4 years’ professional experience in marketing
• Experience in building and working with marketing reporting dashboards.
• Proven success contributing to the development and executing of marketing plans and campaigns for various audiences across B2B and B2C
• Proven ability to work with integrated marketing tools and software including email automation, CRM, analytics, and reporting
• Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to effectively coordinate multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities
• Advanced written and verbal communication skills; clear, professional, and warm communicator
• Initiative, self-starter, and ability to work with little supervision
• Ability to think both tactically and strategically
• Bilingualism (English/French) is an asset

Working Conditions
• Full-time, Monday-Friday, with occasional evening and weekend work
• This position is remote and may be based anywhere in Canada
